customers.why: People the business serves; transactions, visits and segments all point at it.

stores.why: Places the business trades from; transactions and visits point at it.

products.why: Things sold, identified by sku; transactions point at it.

categories.why: Eight labels for products, pointed at only by products.

transactions.why: One row per sale, stamped with purchased_at.

loyalty_visits.why: One row per store visit, stamped with visited_on.

customer_segments.why: Each customer reassessed on six dates; the date repeats across rows.

promo_codes.why: Twenty codes and nothing points at them or from them.

suppliers.why: North and south tables hold disjoint suppliers, one table cut in two.

price_list.why: The same skus priced again in 2025.

members.why: The same member ids listed again in 2025 with a changed tier.

member_visits.why: One row per member visit, stamped with visited_at.
